system.summary: The two 1635 letters mix clear French with cipher bands of digits and invented signs; no 1635 key was verified.
system.sibling_key: The 1637 Saint-Chamond key was inspected as a structural comparison; its use here is unverified.
system.notes: The Rohan letters of 1636 may use a different key. Their paired ciphertext is unavailable in the supplied Français 5190 scan.

prior_solution.where: The cipher bands of Français 3758 nos. 100 and 104 were not found in print in this search.

conditions.human_role: The user supplied the target description, archive URLs and the proposed Savoy/Canisy known-plaintext route.

solution.what: Checked Français 5190; view requests past 90 returned the same final image, manuscript p. 80.
Read the printed Savoy and Canisy plaintext in the 1758 Mémoires and identified Sainte-Geneviève MS 3338 as a second witness for Français 3758.
Transcribed the clear prose of Français 3758 nos. 100 and 104, marking the cipher gaps.
Inspected the published 1637 Saint-Chamond cipher as a structural comparison; no assignment to the 1635 correspondents was established.

outcome.method_basis: No verified key or parallel plaintext for the cipher bands of Français 3758 nos. 100 and 104; the printed Savoy/Canisy plaintext could not be paired with its ciphertext because the Gallica reproduction of Français 5190 stops at p. 80.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No enciphered token in the 1635 letters has a verified value; clear prose is excluded from the fraction.

gaps.detail: No verified key or matching plaintext.
No verified key or matching plaintext.

outcome.notes: The Savoy/Canisy letters are printed deciphered, but the matching manuscript ciphertext and d'Émery's letter are beyond the supplied Français 5190 reproduction. The surrounding clear prose of the 1635 letters is read.
